According to the FAQ for the App, "targets remain in play during their own destruction" (bold in the original).  This confirms something that we have suspected for a while, in the continual evolution of the Damage Dealing Spreadsheet.  So I have gone ahead and combined what were, for a while, two separate steps: "on destruction" effects on the defender, and non-defender "on destruction" effects.

I have a question about an edge case in the comments, that the grognards here might be able to help with:

"Some side effects may lead to the defender being destroyed "again" during this step.  Note that a defender which is double-destroyed in this fashion does not trigger its OWN "when this card is destroyed" effects a second time."

Does this mean that OTHER card destruction triggers *can* happen a second time?  It seems to, but that may just be an accidental wording, from back when there were two separate steps.  It doesn't make intuitive sense to me that you could double-destroy, but only if the effect is on a different card.

Can someone (who has more brain than I have at the moment) please come up with some specific cases where this could really happen, so that we can discuss it in concrete terms?  Or links to prior relevant discussion/rulings?  Thanks.

posts.cooked:
This was officially clarified for the App (sorry if I made it sound like it was known all along).

All on destruction effects happen at the same time, and you can choose the order. The effect on the card itself does not have to happen first.

However, you cannot stop the cards own effect from happening. So, If Haka tries to eat the Sonic Mine, he can put it under Savage Mana first, but that (i.e. the lack of text) cannot stop the card from triggering. The way the App handles this is to put it in a different "zone" to trigger, then puts in under Sonic Mine.

There are 4 main stages that changes to the app move through (and not necessarily in a linear way - we iterate at each stage quite a bit).

  1. Internal development & testing - completely private between Handelabra Games and GTG
  2. Alpha testing - this uses the text-based Mega Computer system, and has a small group of external testers.
  3. Beta testing - this is a version of the real game on iOS, Android & Steam, and has a larger group of external testers
  4. Public release

Each stage in fact has its own Trello boards =). We have quite a few for different parts of the project for internal use, and there's one each for Alpha and Beta. The only public board is SotM Known Issues, which we use to communicate info about major issues in released versions.
